title: "scRNA-seq PBS vs AEC: myeloid trajectory"

output: html_document
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: inline

Single cell RNA-seq of one PBS-treated and one AEC-treated mouse. Ambient RNA was removed with CellBender.
This script was written for Seurat v4. To run it with Seurat v5, keep `options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")` in the setup chunk.

Slingshot and tradeSeq on myeloid subclusters 0, 2, 4 and 5 in the AEC sample.
Starts from `data/cell/Cell_Myeloid2.rds`, saved by `02_myeloid_cells.Rmd`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r load all the packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")

library(cowplot)
library(clustree)
library(niceRplots)
library(scCustomize)
library(harmony)
library(geomtextpath)
library(webr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

#For preprocessing
library(DoubletFinder)

#For Cell interaction
library(CellChat)
library(liana)

#For enrichment Analysis
library(correlationAnalyzeR)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(xlsx)
library(gprofiler2)
library(plotly)
library(DOSE)

#For transcriptional factor network
library(loomR)

#For Trajectory imputation
library(slingshot)
library(tradeSeq)
library(fields)
library(rafalib)

for (d in c("data/cell", "results/cell/Myeloid", "results/cell/Myeloid/Trajectory", "results/cell/Mast", "results/cell/Tcell", "results/cell/Bcell", "results/cell/DC", "results/cell/Neutrophil", "results/cell/Cellchat", "results/cell/LIANA", "results/cell/SCENIC")) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
```


```{r Slingshot}
DATA_Myeloid <- readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Myeloid2.rds")

#Trajectory of subclusters 0, 2, 4, 5 in AEC----
DATA<-subset(DATA_Myeloid %>% SetIdent(value = "seurat_subclusters"), idents= c("0", "2",  "4", "5"))
DATA<- subset(DATA %>% SetIdent(value = "Condition"), idents="AEC")
DATA$seurat_subclusters <- droplevels(factor(DATA$seurat_subclusters))

#Generate 3D Umap----
DefaultAssay(DATA) <- "CCA"
DATA <- ScaleData(DATA, features = rownames(DATA))
DATA <- RunPCA(DATA, npcs = 30)
DATA <- RunUMAP(DATA, dims = 1:30)
DATA<- RunUMAP(DATA, dims = 1:30, n.components = 3, reduction.name = "umap_3d")
DefaultAssay(DATA) <- "RNA"
DimPlot(DATA, group.by = "seurat_subclusters")

#Plot 3D----
df <- data.frame(DATA@reductions$umap_3d@cell.embeddings, variable = factor(DATA$seurat_subclusters))
colnames(df)[1:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2", "UMAP_3")
p_State <- plot_ly(df, x = ~UMAP_1, y = ~UMAP_2, z = ~UMAP_3, color = ~variable, size = 0.5)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p_State, selfcontained = T, "results/cell/Myeloid/Trajectory/umap_3d_clustering_plotly.html")
p_State

# Calculate cluster centroids (for plotting the labels later)----
mm <- sparse.model.matrix(~0 + factor(DATA$seurat_subclusters))
colnames(mm) <- levels(factor(DATA$seurat_subclusters))
centroids2d <- as.matrix(t(t(DATA@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings) %*% mm)/Matrix::colSums(mm))
pal <- c((scales::hue_pal())(8), RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Set1"), RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8,"Set2"))

#Trajectory imputation----
set.seed(1)
lineages <- as.SlingshotDataSet(getLineages(
  data           = DATA@reductions$umap_3d@cell.embeddings,
  clusterLabels  = DATA$seurat_subclusters,
  start.clus     = "4"
  ))

#Plot Lineage
lineages@reducedDim <- DATA@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
plot(DATA@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings, col = pal[DATA$seurat_subclusters],  cex=.5,pch = 16)
lines(lineages, lwd = 1, col = 'black', cex=2 )
text(centroids2d, labels = rownames(centroids2d),cex=0.8,font=2,col = "white")

#Defining Principal Curves----
curves <- as.SlingshotDataSet(getCurves(data = lineages, thresh = 0.01, stretch = 0.1, allow.breaks = F, approx_points = 1000))
plot(DATA@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings, col = pal[DATA$seurat_subclusters], pch = 16)
lines(curves, lwd = 2, col = "black")
text(centroids2d, labels = rownames(centroids2d), cex = 1, font = 2)

#Compute pseudotime----
pseudotime <- slingPseudotime(curves, na = FALSE)
cellWeights <- slingCurveWeights(curves)

x <- rowMeans(pseudotime)
x <- x/max(x)
o <- order(x)
pt_pal = colorRampPalette(c("grey70", "orange3", "firebrick", "purple4"))
plot(DATA@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings[o, ], main = paste0("pseudotime"), pch = 16,
    cex = 0.4, axes = T, xlab = "", ylab = "",col = pt_pal(99)[x[o] * 98 + 1])
lines(curves, lwd = 2, col = "black")
colorbar.plot( 5, 2.5,  1:99, horizontal = F,col = pt_pal(99))
points(centroids2d, cex = 2.5, pch = 16, col = "#FFFFFF99")
text(centroids2d, labels = rownames(centroids2d), cex = 1, font = 2)

#plot pseudotime together with clusters
par(mar = c(4,4,2,2), xpd = T, mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(DATA@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings, col = pal[DATA$seurat_subclusters],  cex=.5,pch = 16)
text(centroids2d, labels = rownames(centroids2d),cex=0.8,font=2,col = "black")
legend("topright", legend = levels(DATA$seurat_subclusters), pch= 16,col  = pal[seq_along(levels(DATA$seurat_subclusters))],cex=0.8)
plot(DATA@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings[o, ], main = paste0("pseudotime"), pch = 16,
    cex = 0.4, axes = F, xlab = "", ylab = "", col = pt_pal(99)[x[o] * 98 + 1])


#TradeSeq ----
# 190 cells per subcluster
sel_cells <- split(colnames(DATA), DATA$seurat_subclusters)
sel_cells <- unlist(lapply(sel_cells, function(x) {set.seed(1)
  return(sample(x, min(190, length(x))))}))

gv <- as.data.frame(na.omit(scran::modelGeneVar(DATA@assays$RNA@data[, sel_cells])))
gv <- gv[order(gv$bio, decreasing = T), ]
sel_genes <- sort(rownames(gv)[1:2000])
sceGAM <- fitGAM(counts = drop0(DATA@assays$RNA@counts[sel_genes, sel_cells]), pseudotime = pseudotime[sel_cells,
    ], cellWeights = cellWeights[sel_cells, ], nknots = 5, verbose = T, parallel = T,
    sce = TRUE, BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam())
plotGeneCount(curves, clusters = DATA$seurat_subclusters, models = sceGAM)

#Associated Gene with pseudotime and find lineage specific marker
lc <- sapply(lineages@lineages, function(x) {
    rev(x)[1]
})
names(lc) <- gsub("Lineage", "", names(lc))

mypar()
plot(DATA@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings, col = pal[DATA$seurat_subclusters], pch = 16)
lines(curves, lwd = 2, col = "black")
points(centroids2d[lc, ], col = "black", pch = 16, cex = 3)
text(centroids2d[lc, ], labels = names(lc), cex = 1, font = 2, col = "white")

#Save the psudotime association Genelist
res <- na.omit(associationTest(sceGAM, contrastType = "consecutive"))
res <- res[res$pvalue < 0.005, ]
res <- res[res$waldStat > mean(res$waldStat), ]
res <- res[order(res$waldStat, decreasing = T), ]
res$gene <- rownames(res)
write_csv(res, "results/cell/Myeloid/Trajectory/Psudo_Gene.csv")

#Save the gene list between two psudotime point
res <- na.omit(startVsEndTest(sceGAM, pseudotimeValues = c(6, 18.9)))
res <- res[res$pvalue < 0.005, ]
res <- res[res$waldStat > mean(res$waldStat), ]
res <- res[order(res$waldStat, decreasing = T), ]
res$gene <- rownames(res)
write_csv(res, "results/cell/Myeloid/Trajectory/Psudo_Gene6_18.9.csv")

#Genes that are different between lineages
res <- na.omit(diffEndTest(sceGAM))
res <- res[res$pvalue < 0.001, ]
res <- res[res$waldStat > mean(res$waldStat), ]
res <- res[order(res$waldStat, decreasing = T), ]
res$gene <- rownames(res)
write_csv(res, "results/cell/Myeloid/Trajectory/Lineage_Gene.csv")

#Plot MHC-II genes along pseudotime
plot_list = list()
for (sigGeneStart in intersect(c("H2-Aa",   "H2-Ab1",  "H2-DMa",  "H2-DMb1","H2-Eb1"  ,"Cd74", "Cd274"), sel_genes)){
print(sigGeneStart)
plot_list[[sigGeneStart]]<- plotSmoothers(sceGAM, counts=drop0(DATA@assays$RNA@counts[sel_genes, sel_cells]), gene = sigGeneStart) + ggtitle(sigGeneStart)
}
plot_grid(ncol = 2, plotlist = plot_list)

VlnPlot(DATA,features = c("H2-Aa", "H2-Ab1",  "H2-DMa", "H2-DMb1", "H2-DMb2","H2-Eb1", "H2-M3", "H2-Ob", "H2-Q10",  "H2-T23","Cd74"))
```
